title: Habit 3: Put First Things First
coreMove: Put first things first by giving important nonurgent work a protected place before interruptions dress themselves as duty.

exampleSpecs.stakes: training may lose to constant urgent coverage
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: schedule important nonurgent work before urgent gaps take over

exampleSpecs.stakes: lab prep may be buried by email requests
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: convert values into a weekly appointment

exampleSpecs.stakes: a key reliability fix may vanish under minor tickets
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: protect the high-value block from easy activity

exampleSpecs.stakes: month-end pressure may erase process improvement
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: invest in prevention while numbers demand attention

exampleSpecs.stakes: career growth may lose to paid fragments
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: honor the role goal before the day fragments

exampleSpecs.stakes: work messages may consume the only family meal
